systems.country_label: GIS based digital revenue management system
systems.owner: Supported by German cooperation, with the Netherlands contributing software for revenue collection and fiscal cadastres
systems.tiers: MMDA level; Germany gives technical support to 100 MMDAs including all 16 regional capitals; the number of assemblies using the system is not stated

note: The European partners' programme supports assemblies' revenue software, urban e-services and digital transformation at MMDA level, and targets 5 MMDAs or institutions using GIS-based revenue tools; it states nothing about the connection of assembly offices.
